algorithms.alpha: bilinear x2 + Gaussian sigma 8/3 truncate 3; protected regions and portal zero
algorithms.glow: max(linear709(lit)-linear709(clean),0)*alpha; within EN-01 light support; peak normalised
algorithms.sakura: clean sRGB HSV hue265..350 saturation>=.20 value>=.15 in continued cherry zones; exact disc24 closing, fill holes, discard components<400; subtract unchanged woody/protection and local static stone; Gaussian sigma4 truncate3; hard zero woody/protection/stone/outside cherry, no pigment reclip
algorithms.mist: continued front-cliff; triangular vertical ramp; inward side feather32
algorithms.petals: exact uint8 grayscale disk dilation radius24, protected regions reapplied

visual_review.local_decision: Full east crown crop revealed a lilac stone-pedestal highlight in the prescribed pigment envelope. Added separate static stone exclusion, without changing woody/protection; envelope coverage is measured before every exclusion.
limitations: No semantic label for every tiny painted twig: explicit woody cores and direct crown inspection are the evidence.
Masks are geometric envelopes. Small background gaps enclosed within a blossom crown intentionally move with the crown; they are not a per-blossom cutout.
K1 is image-plane framing and K2 crops, not live engine evidence. The portal is accepted as a static warm-door anchor under ??-VS3-EN04-02; no glass-centroid claim is made.
iteration_history: Fix1 prescribed HSV plus crown morphology: coverage 87.4339%, largest-two share91.3705%; 100% review identified static stone reflection.
Fix1 local stone exclusion: coverage86.7013%, largest-two share91.2907%; reopened final master, working and 100% colour/gray sheets.

limitations: Portal has zero lit-clean difference; its glow-mask centroid is undefined. A static lit-luminance emitter centroid is provided instead; portal is not lantern glass.
The glass centroid is measured inside each glass ROI. The unrestricted pool centroid is also recorded and can lie off the glass.
K1/K2 sheets are registered image-plane framing/crops, not live game camera captures; Unreal access was prohibited.
HSV-derived coherent envelopes plus woody exclusions are not a semantic proof about every tiny painted twig. Direct PNG review is recorded separately.
All seven PNG colour/alpha buffers cannot be zero in the protected field: lanterns RGB must equal lit RGB. All five masks, all anim channels and lantern alpha are zero there.

sakura_coherence.static_stone_note: Local semantic exclusion of lilac reflected light on the east pedestal identified at 100%; E remains measured before every exclusion. No woody/protection edits.
